title: The coax output style is kept in the repo
body:
The Claude output style coax runs with, `coax.md`, lives in the trial profile's `output-styles/` folder under `tmp-claude/2026-11-08-coax-style/claude-config`, which git ignores. Changes to it, such as the commands section (coax-5e39b9), the merged draft (coax-3d286f) and the Colour section, reach no commit. The style describes what coax draws, so it goes stale when coax changes and nothing records which version matched which commit.

## Proposal

The style lives in the repo as `styles/coax.md` and changes with the code it describes. The profile folder links or copies it. guise-5d4990, which moves the profile into a guise profile, takes the file from there.

## Open

- A link keeps the profile current with no step, but breaks if Claude Code rewrites the file by replacing it. A copy needs a step after each change.
